# ForexFactoryScrapper

> A stateless Flask REST API service that aggregates and serves economic calendar events from ForexFactory, CryptoCraft, EnergyExch, and MetalsMine, powered by the upstream `forex-pytory` Python package.

- Site: https://atacanymc.github.io/ForexFactoryScrapper/
- Repository: https://github.com/AtaCanYmc/ForexFactoryScrapper
- Upstream Parser: https://github.com/AtaCanYmc/forex-pytory
- License: MIT

## Quick Start

### Docker
```bash
docker build -t forexfactory-scrapper .
docker run -d -p 5000:5000 --name forexfactory-scrapper forexfactory-scrapper
curl -f http://localhost:5000/api/health
```

### Local (Python 3.10–3.12)
```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py
```

## HTTP Endpoints

- `GET /`: HTML landing page with navigation links.
- `GET /api/hello`: Basic sanity check endpoint.
- `GET /api/health`: Service health check. Add `?probe=true` for upstream latency and peak memory.
- `GET /api/forex/daily?day=<1-31>&month=<1-12>&year=<YYYY>&limit=<N>&offset=<N>`: ForexFactory daily economic calendar events.
- `GET /api/cryptocraft/daily?day=<1-31>&month=<1-12>&year=<YYYY>&limit=<N>&offset=<N>`: CryptoCraft daily calendar events.
- `GET /api/energyexch/daily?day=<1-31>&month=<1-12>&year=<YYYY>&limit=<N>&offset=<N>`: EnergyExch daily calendar events.
- `GET /api/metalsmine/daily?day=<1-31>&month=<1-12>&year=<YYYY>&limit=<N>&offset=<N>`: MetalsMine daily calendar events.
- `GET /api/bundle?start_date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&end_date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&sources=forex,crypto,energy,metal&limit=<N>&offset=<N>`: Multi-source date-range aggregation.
- `GET /api/forex/sitemaps?start_date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&end_date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&max_pages=<N>&limit=<N>&offset=<N>`: Paginated ForexFactory sitemap URLs.
- `GET /swagger`: Swagger UI console.
- `GET /openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3.0 schema definition (`src/openapi_spec.py`).

## Environment Variables

- `HOST` (String, default `127.0.0.1`, `0.0.0.0` in Docker): Bind interface.
- `PORT` (Integer, default `5000`): HTTP port.
- `DEBUG` (Boolean, default `False`): Flask debug mode.
- `CORS_ORIGINS` (CSV, default `*`): Allowed CORS origins.
- `MAX_BUNDLE_DAYS` (Integer, default `31`): Maximum date span for `/api/bundle`.
- `MAX_SITEMAP_PAGES` (Integer, default `100`): Maximum sitemap pages to crawl.
- `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` (Integer, default `0`): In-memory upstream cache TTL, `0` disables.
- `CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES` (Integer, default `256`): Maximum cached responses.
- `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` (Integer, default `0`): Per-client request cap on `/api/*`, `0` disables.
- `LOG_FORMAT` (`text` or `json`, default `text`): JSON lines for log aggregators.
- `LOG_LEVEL` (String, default `INFO`): Logging level.
- `TRUST_PROXY_HOPS` (Integer, default `0`): Trusted reverse-proxy hops.
- `DOTENV_PATH` (Path, default `None`): Explicit `.env` file path.

## Architecture Notes

- Stateless HTTP layer: no database. Requests trigger live upstream fetches via `forex-pytory` unless the optional in-process cache is enabled.
- Deployment: `docker-compose.yml` (Caddy reverse proxy with TLS) and a Helm chart in `deploy/helm/forexfactory-scrapper`.
- Strict validation: invalid dates or negative pagination values return `HTTP 400` with `{"error": "..."}`.
